intro: Explore the record. The 1976 paper says the rise was not steady and had recently accelerated — test that idea with today's data.
suggested_questions: Compare the mean growth rate of each decade since the 1960s. Is CO₂ growth accelerating?
Your 1959→1971 rise differs from 3.4%. Is the difference larger than the stated measurement uncertainty?
